breakthrough: Visual production adapts automatically to each target platform
lane: Software-product roadmaps derived from the earlier idea catalog
outcome: Move art from concept through generation, editing, LODs, materials, compression, and engine import

subphases.name: 1.1 2D 3D Art Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed stages, artifacts, dependencies, transformations, and checkpoints required to move art from concept through generation, editing, lods, materials, compression, and engine import, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for game production, agent tools, creative systems, simulation, compilers, testing, and engine integration; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 2D 3D Art Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: move art from concept through generation, editing, lods, materials, compression, and engine import.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make 2D 3D Art Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 2D 3D Art Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using multi-agent orchestration, procedural generation, simulation, optimization, and multimodal AI.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 2D 3D Art Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the production studio UI, engine plugins, visual editors, live dashboards, and SDKs, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale 2D 3D Art into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 2D 3D Art Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 2D 3D Art Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: Visual production adapts automatically to each target platform. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.
